description: This file implements a mock version of the AnalyticsBackend interface for testing purposes. It includes methods for configuring the backend, sending events, and interacting with local storage and network via curl. It also defines a class AnalyticsBackendMock that simulates event handling and network communication.

classes.name: AnalyticsBackendMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IAnalyticsBackend interface for testing analytics event handling and network communication.

methods.name: CurlWriteCallback
methods.description: A callback function for handling data received from curl during HTTP requests.

methods.name: AnalyticsBackendMock
methods.description: Constructor initializing the mock backend and logging creation.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the backend implementation.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the backend with system time and local store, setting up the local storage parameters.

methods.name: SendEvent
methods.description: Prepares a JSON event, stores it locally, and attempts to send it over HTTP using curl, handling responses and errors.
